effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand. Then, if [Growlmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon gains "[On Deletion] You may play 1 card with [Guilmon] in its name from your trash without paying the cost."
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon is deleted, gain 1 memory.
